verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch documents retrieval APIs suited to RAG. Semantic_text auto-embeds content at index time, hybrid search combines full-text and vector search in one request with RRF, and the docs explicitly name RAG and question answering systems as target use cases. The release notes also mention passing settings through to OpenAI chat completion requests, which hints at answer generation. The core retrieval half of the story is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: a documented first-party answer/conversational generation API or RAG end-to-end guide, and independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can power RAG and conversational answers on top of my indexes with documented retrieval or answer APIs

citations.quote: RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems; Geospatial search applications; Question answering systems
Hybrid search runs full-text search and vector search in one request.
When you index content into a `semantic_text` field, Elasticsearch automatically generates vector embeddings using a configured machine learning model and stores them in the underlying vector field.
Vector and hybrid search, reranking, and GPU inference in one API. Build fast, relevant AI apps and agents on context you can trust.
